edbDesc: (or Inverse Magnetostrictive Effect) The change of the magnetic susceptibility of a material when subjected to a mechanical stress.
title: Villari Effect
pickWhy: The reverse of magnetostriction (stress changes magnetism), as converse piezoelectricity is part of piezoelectricity; canonical 'magnetostriction' is in another batch. That card can name magnetoelastic torque sensors.
